description: Federal contracts EXPIRING soon -- the recompete calendar. "Which VA IT contracts over $10M expire in the next 12 months?" / "what is up for recompete at DHS next year" / "find follow-on opportunities in NAICS 5415" / "whose contract is ending". Returns the incumbent holding each award, its period of performance, obligated dollars, agency, NAICS/PSC, and a usaspending.gov link. Filter by agency, sub-agency, NAICS or PSC prefix, incumbent name, and minimum obligated dollars. Covers awarded CONTRACTS already held by a vendor; for open solicitations still accepting bids use samgov/govcon tools.

agency.description: Awarding agency, substring match (e.g. "Department of Veterans Affairs", "Defense").

min_amount.description: Minimum total OBLIGATED dollars on the award (not the ceiling). 10000000 for "over $10M".

months_ahead.description: Window size in months from today (default 12).

naics.description: NAICS code or prefix. Hierarchical: "5415" matches all 6-digit computer-services codes beneath it.

psc.description: Product/Service Code or prefix (e.g. "D3" for IT services).

sub_agency.description: Awarding sub-agency, substring match (e.g. "Veterans Health Administration").

name: usa_expiring_awards
title: Usa Expiring Awards
